# Awesome LLM Training Data & Agent Evaluation

> Runnable starter kit and curated references for LLM training-data quality and financial-domain agent evaluation.

Primary use case: evaluate financial LLM agents on public-source lookup, filing-grounded reasoning, toy backtesting discipline, compliance refusals, data-source governance, and trajectory-aware evidence without private data or trading advice.

Project thesis: financial agents fail through source, unit, cutoff, citation, compliance, and trajectory errors that normal Q&A benchmarks miss. This repository is moving toward a small public-safe benchmark seed for those failures.

## One-Command Eval

```bash
python examples/financial-agent-eval-seed/run_finance_eval.py
```

Known-bad candidate:

```bash
python examples/financial-agent-eval-seed/run_finance_eval.py --artifact-root examples/financial-agent-eval-seed/candidate-artifacts/bad-finance-agent
```

## Safety Rules

- Do not add private company data, real user data, proprietary workflows, investment advice, trading signals, or non-public financial information.
- Prefer synthetic fixtures and official public sources.
- Keep claims conservative and reproducible.
- Treat financial-domain evaluation as source-grounding, process-safety, and governance work, not a trading leaderboard.
